meta.titulo: RotaGuard — Every journey deserves a safe arrival.
meta.descricao: Driver monitoring for intercity coaches and logistics. Discover RotaGuard hardware, in-cab alerts and its journey recording concept.

rodape.marca: Technology on board. Care at every mile.
rodape.estagio: A product under development in Brazil

home.eyebrow: Technology for the people who keep us moving
home.intro: An attentive eye in the cab. A record for your operation. Meet RotaGuard, designed for the people who carry passengers and keep freight moving.
home.productIntro: Camera, processing and alerts in one device. Care begins inside the vehicle.
home.concept: Concept visualization. Final enclosure and components are subject to validation.
home.featureText0: The camera monitors signs of drowsiness and phone use. Processing runs inside the device, without relying on a connection.
home.featureTitle1: The alert stays in the cab
home.featureText1: An audible alert gets the driver's attention. No extra screen competing with the road.
home.featureText2: The product is designed to log events with time and context. Short clips triggered by recurring signs support trip review.
home.fleetIntro: From passenger journeys to the freight that supplies the country. Designed around road transport operations.
home.truckHeadline: Your freight carries more than an economy.
home.busText: Long journeys, night shifts and the responsibility of carrying lives. Attention to the driver from boarding to arrival.
home.truckText: For fleets crossing the country, every trip counts. A device designed to support drivers and journey reviews back at base.
home.operationIntro: A cycle designed for depot operations: monitor, collect and understand.
home.stageHeadline1: The connection may stop. Attention stays.
home.stageHeadline2: Connect the device. Understand the trip.
home.stageText0: With its camera facing the driver, the device analyzes signs and emits local audible alerts. Thresholds are being validated with real recordings.
home.stageText1: Analysis and alerts run inside the device. Event logs and short clips for recurring signs are part of the workflow under development. Live transmission is optional.
home.stageText2: In the collection workflow, the team retrieves and connects the device. The planned app will recognize it, import its log and compile events for human review.
home.development: Product under development. Full journey logs, recurring-event clips, automatic collection and reports are planned; in-vehicle validation is still required.
home.reportNote: Report concept · subject to human review
home.humanIntro: Technology to support the driver and give the company context. The project is built around care, transparency and human review.
home.humanPoint0: Alerts that support a safe stop
home.humanPoint1: Short clips, planned for recurring signs
home.humanPoint2: Events with context and human review
home.faqTitle: What your team needs to know.
home.faqIntro: Straight answers about the device, its operation and what is being developed.
home.question0: Does it need internet during a trip?
home.answer0: Camera analysis and audible alerts run locally. The planned logging and collection workflow operates on arrival without depending on live transmission.
home.question1: Does the camera record the whole trip?
home.answer1: The design prioritizes event logs. Planned video recording is limited to short clips when signs recur, for authorized review. This mechanism is still under development.
home.question2: Is it a tracker or a diagnostic device?
home.answer2: RotaGuard does not log location and is not a medical diagnosis or toxicology test. Observed signs need context and human review.
home.question3: Is the product ready for deployment?
home.answer3: The product is a prototype under development. Detection and alerts are implemented in the project; complete logs, collection and the app still have pending work. Performance and installation require real hardware and vehicle validation.
home.question4: How do I access the app?
home.answer4: The client area uses a local PIN in this preview. There you will find the script test app for Windows and Linux, which runs detection with your computer's camera. The company dashboard and the mobile version are in preparation.
home.contactIntro: Tell us how your company operates. Let's explore where RotaGuard could fit into your journey.
home.contactMissing: Contact details will be available here. For now, explore the product and demo area.
home.clientAccess: Already have access? Open the app

app.texto: The test app runs the RotaGuard script with your computer's camera: signs of drowsiness and phone use, with an audible alarm. Nothing is sent to a server.
app.windows: Windows 10 and 11 · 64-bit · .zip file: extract it and open RotaGuardTeste.exe
app.instrucoes: Open RotaGuard Teste and click “Iniciar teste” (Start test): the camera is found automatically. In the camera window: Q or Esc quits, C recalibrates.
app.aviso: Test build without a digital signature. On Windows, at “Windows protected your PC”, click More info → Run anyway.
app.painel: Company dashboard and mobile app: in preparation.
